import importlib

print('helper=', v31.python_bare_truthy_or_operand(line))
print('marker=', getattr(r, v31.APPLIED_MARKER, False))

print('added=', [(x.path, x.line, x.text) for x in r.hardened.iter_added_diff_lines(diff)])
print('sentinels=', [(x.path, x.line, x.label, x.text) for x in r.detect_risk_sentinels(diff, None)])
